page.overview:
What is Dominique Weasley?

Dominique Weasley (b. 2000s) was a part-Veela witch and the second daughter of Bill and Fleur Weasley . She had two other siblings, Victoire and Louis Weasley. It is possible that Dominique lived at Shell Cottage.

is the French feminine form of the masculine name Dominic, derived from the Late Latin Dominicus, meaning "of the Lord". It was traditionally given to a child born on Sunday in Catholic countries. It is also the name of a popular French by Soeur Sourire, the Belgian "Singing Nun", about Saint Dominic and his fight against the Albigensians.
